title: Redis dependency failure and cache degradation
root_cause: Redis unavailability or cache timeouts can increase latency and origin load.
resolution: Propose approved cache bypass or failover with bounded traffic and monitor database load.
pattern: Redis timeouts, falling cache hit ratio and rising checkout latency
diagnostic: Inspect Redis health, cache hit ratio, network reachability and downstream database pressure.
text: Synthetic V2 runbook. A Redis failure can cause secondary database pressure. Follow the checkout-to-Redis dependency before attributing all latency to Postgres. Confirm direct cache errors and metrics. Cache bypass is a mitigation with a capacity risk; require human approval and verify error rate, latency and origin database load afterward.
